description: Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT): public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT). Coverage: Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT). The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Locals per activitat principal (CNAE-93), tram d'assalariats i període; Nombre d'empreses concursades per període i tram d'antiguitat. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
